changes: New: SCENE GEN, scenes generated around the Part's values (PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER).
Locks page-1 parameters of the active track or all eight into scene A, scene B, all sixteen scenes, or a sixteen-scene walk.
SCN SPREAD sets how far they move; LEVEL to the left on SCENE GEN restores the scenes as they were.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta). Card firmware cannot include it.
Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator.
